EN:
Hey, maaaannnnn,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} how's about you
gimme that scallop you caught?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}

Scram, ya moocher!
ES:
Eh, primate, ¡¿qué tal si me das
esa vieira que has cogido?!{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Bueno, vale...
¡No te lo crees ni tú!

Hé, maaaannnnn,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} tu me le donnes ce

quella capasanta che hai pescato?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}

Hey, Maaann!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Wie wär's, wenn du

Äh... hier, bitte.
Nichts da!

Hey dostuuum,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} yakaladığın şu
deniz tarağını
bana versene?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}

Hadi oradan, beleşçi!

de idea?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ¿Me darás la vieira?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}

Hé maaaann, et maintenant ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Tu me
le files ce pétoncle ?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}
Bon, d'accord...
Tu rêves !

Hey, Maaann!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Willst du mir diesmal
vielleicht deine Kammmuschel
geben?{{TAG:000F:0005:15002800}}

NEIN!
